context: A teacher and student discuss a historical paper
purpose: Teach: 澤/藩/狂っ/秘め/消極/格段/懇親/突っ込み

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、澤家に伝わる藩士の資料、丁寧に扱っていますね。
lines.en: You're handling the Sawa family's historical materials with real care here.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly surprised in the best way. Leans forward with genuine interest. Steady pace, each word given its weight. Not lecturing—noticing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。狂った時代と評されながらも、人々が秘めた信念を浮き彫りに。
lines.en: Yes. Even in a time people called chaotic, it brings out the convictions these people carried inside.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost professorial but not distant. Slight pause before the main idea—gathering the thought. Quiet pride underneath. Voice lifts gently on the core insight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 消極的な立場の人物、丁寧に描いている章、格段に説得力ありますね。
lines.en: The chapters on the people who took passive positions—those are genuinely persuasive.
lines.style: Engaged lean-in. Recognition of real work done right. Warm encouragement without condescension. Slight emphasis on 'genuinely' like she means it. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 懇親会で、地元の郷土史家にお話を伺えました。
lines.en: I was able to talk with a local historian at a networking event about it.
lines.style: Opening with modest quiet. Then slight brightening—remembering that conversation. Not boasting, but allowing himself to claim the good thing that happened. Conversational and steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 査読の突っ込み、明日対応しましょう。
lines.en: The reviewer feedback—let's tackle that tomorrow.
lines.style: Shift to practical, grounding tone. Gentle authority without pressure. A knowing smile underneath—she's read the comments too. Closing with reassurance: you've got this, and I've got your back on it.
